title: Strong Consistency, Optimal Tracking and Sharp Rates for the Åström-Wittenmark Self-Tuning Regulator with Unknown Input Gain
summary: We study strong consistency and optimal tracking of the Astrom-Wittenmark self-tuning regulator with unknown input gain. Existing results establish consistency of all parameter estimates for the unmodified recursion under additional growth conditions on reference information. Other approaches obtain stability and optimal tracking by adjusting the estimates used in feedback or adding decaying probing signals.
